annotations.title: What the documents say a refund would be

description:
For a private test or specialist visit and the amount paid: per insurer and cover we checked, what the document lets us say about the refund. Where the document can be read two ways, both numbers; where it gives no number, why. Only the covers we checked; the person's own policy decides.
שילמתי על בדיקה או רופא פרטי: כמה יחזירו לפי מה שכתוב במסמכים, כולל שתי קריאות כשהמסמך לא מכריע.

amount_paid.description: What the person paid, in ILS

company.description: The person’s insurer, if they named it (Hebrew or English): the answer is then only that company, and much shorter. Without it: every company, alphabetical.

in_network.description: Was the doctor/institute in the insurer's network (הסדר)?

service.description: Service key from list_topics.refund_services (e.g. mri, ct, specialist_visit, neurologist_visit) or a test/specialty name
